regenerate. All money values are on the ×100 economy scale (DESIGN §4.5).*

## Core constants

32×32 grid; **4 AP per turn** (`maxAp`); warp-in / spawn radius **R:6**; zoom ladder 5→32 (19 steps, wheel notch 100 px, ≤3 steps per event). Nebulae: effective scan 1, cloak at d ≤ 1. Shields: non-railgun hit on a raised bubble deals 1 damage + strip; a raised bubble adds +1 effective HP in a ram. Default difficulty NORMAL.

## Difficulty profiles

| Profile | AP | Mistake % | Look-ahead | Focus fire | seqCost | beliefDecay |
|---|---:|---:|---:|:--:|---:|---:|
| EASY | 3 | 30% | 1 | no | 60 | 0.55 |
| NORMAL | 4 | 12% | 2 | yes | 35 | 0.75 |
| HARD | 4 | 4% | 2 | yes | 20 | 0.85 |
| ACE | 5 | 0% | 3 | yes | 10 | 0.9 |

Lower `seqCost` lets harder AIs chain longer action sequences; `beliefDecay` rises so tougher AIs remember spotted enemies longer.

## Ability and status flags

- **`!flagship`** — Command Locus: Losing all friendly !flagship units triggers immediate defeat. Immune to #space marines boarding capture.
- **`#capital ship`** — Capital hull: no warp role. Only the !flagship anchors a 1 AP reserve summon (visible empty cell within 3).
- **`#railgun`** — Hyper-Velocity Spinal Mount: Breaks enemy +shield bubbles and deals full firepower to hull HP.
- **`#space marines`** — Boarding Contingent: Can capture adjacent (d <= 1) spotted non-flagship enemy vessels.
- **`#shield generator`** — Deflector Array: Can spend 1 AP (S badge on self) to raise +shield. No cooldown: a stripped bubble can be raised again later in the same turn (1 AP each).
- **`+shield`** — Active Octagon Bubble: Reduces non-railgun hit to 1 HP damage and collapses. Drops when firing.
- **`-moved`** — Helm Exhausted: Drive plumes extinguished; hull rendered in white for the rest of this turn.
- **`-sent boarding party`** — Marines Deployed: Boarding clamps expended for the rest of this turn.
- **`-attacked`** — Ordnance Cycled: Weapons offline for the rest of this turn.

## Campaign start

Wallet 25,000 ⒸB; starting fleet: Flagship Battlecruiser, Fighter, Fighter, Attack Frigate, Probe. Cargo: goods 0 / fuel 20 / crew 0 / parts 5. Battle corner capacity 4 deployed (overflow → battle reserve). Start location `sol-gate`; clock month 1, year 2401.
